reviewItem.question: Does "Use Annotation-Based Tracking by Default: The default behavior for tracking resources has changed to use annotation-based tracking instead of label-based…" mean a change to config-key:argo-cd|path=application.resourceTrackingMethod|component=argocd-cm (default-changed)?

proposed.statement: The default value of the application.resourceTrackingMethod configuration in the argocd-cm ConfigMap changes from label-based tracking to annotation-based tracking in Argo CD 3.0.
